scope: Compact export of recorded measurements; detailed arrays removed, not a new experiment.

measurement.complete_observation_key: All53 publisher fields, including tuple and timestamps, excluding onlyLabel/Attack; literal raw CSV field text.
measurement.time_tuple_key: Start/end plus ordered5tuple; duplicate keys with different remaining fields are not proven duplicate packets.
measurement.caveat: Consistency audit of exported table only, not validation of packet-level ground truth. No contradictory label is relabeled or removed.
